why: agent/src/rpc.ts implements keccak256 by hand so the tool has zero runtime dependencies. That is the highest-risk code in the repository: a subtle error would make the canary bytecode pin compare against a wrong digest, and the failure would be silent. This is the differential test against an independent implementation.
method: deterministic byte patterns at every length that straddles the 136-byte Keccak rate boundary and beyond, three distinct inputs per length, digests compared byte for byte
additionalOracles: keccak256("") equals the published empty-string vector c5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470
keccak256("Flightcheck(address,bytes32,uint256)") reproduces the event topic0 observed in real receipts onchain
keccak256("ping(bytes32)") reproduces the 0x33d425c4 selector present in the deployed contract's calldata
hashing the runtime bytecode fetched from Base Sepolia reproduces the pin recorded before deployment
reproduce: node --experimental-strip-types -e 'see evidence/keccak-differential.json method' , or simply: cast code 0x2A6FC8182Bf9928Ef7517dA980dC79e8107c555A --rpc-url https://sepolia.base.org | cast keccak
